generation_fact: One atomic relation established by an execution: its source information, realized transformation, concrete occurrence, formed outcome, and relation role.
generation_occurrence: One concrete execution; it can establish several generation facts, but the occurrence is not interchangeable with any of those facts.
atomic_generation_fact: Each fact preserves its exact source, transformation, occurrence, outcome, and role as one indivisible record, even when an occurrence establishes multiple facts.
realizes_fact: Connects a concrete occurrence only to each distinct generation fact that the occurrence actually established.
reads_from: Records an actual data dependency and must be followed when establishing how a later execution used an earlier result.
GeneratedOrigin: Allows an outcome formed by an earlier fact to participate as the exact source of a later fact.
program_order: Records declared execution order but does not, by itself, establish a data dependency or concurrency.
equal_values: Equal numeric values or equal outputs do not identify the same fact, occurrence, result, or formation history.
cartesian_recombination: Facts from an occurrence must not be split into source and result sets and recombined by Cartesian product; only the recorded atomic pairings are valid.
missing_relations: A missing edge means that the relation was not established; it is not automatically proof that the relation is false, and absent concurrency edges do not prove concurrency.
forward_query: Follow exact identities along training sample to batch occurrence to forward occurrence to loss to backward occurrence to gradient to optimizer occurrence to new parameter version.
reverse_query: Start from the exact evaluation or parameter result and traverse actual reads_from, GeneratedOrigin, realizes_fact, and incidence relations in reverse; timestamp proximity and numeric similarity are not substitutes.
